question: What is the true source of the appearance of division?
premises: The self alone has that ultimate nature.
The self appears in divided forms.
This appearing as division is the very nature of consciousness.
inference: Division is not external to the self but is consciousness manifesting according to its own nature.
plain_english: Indeed the self alone, being of that nature, appears just so through division; for this is the very nature of consciousness, and that alone is what appears.
